lines.zh: 我在海带丛里挪步，像一根会走的茎。
lines.en: I shuffle through the kelp beds, a walking stalk.

lines.zh: 水从我鳃边滑过，脚印立刻被沙填平。
lines.en: Water slips past my gills and the sand fills my prints.

lines.zh: 我顺着洋流飘，脚几乎不碰到海床。
lines.en: I drift with the current, my feet barely touching the seabed.

lines.zh: 别踩海带，那是我藏身的地方。
lines.en: Do not trample the kelp; that is where I hide.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，身后拖着一整条海带卷。
lines.en: I walk slowly, dragging a whole kelp roll behind me.

lines.zh: 每一步都吐出细小的气泡，像在数路。
lines.en: Each step releases tiny bubbles, as if counting the way.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石爬，皮肤上的盐粒沙沙响。
lines.en: I crawl along the reef, salt grains rasping on my skin.

lines.zh: 河水太淡，我只在咸水里走得稳。
lines.en: River water is too fresh; I only walk steady in salt.

lines.zh: 我游过沉船，把海带当成帘子掀开。
lines.en: I swim past a wreck and push the kelp aside like a curtain.

lines.zh: 走远些，我身上滴下的水会弄湿你的靴子。
lines.en: Keep back; the water dripping off me will soak your boots.

lines.zh: 我把卷曲的叶柄收在身下，免得绊住。
lines.en: I tuck my curled stalk under me so it will not trip.

lines.zh: 潮水退时我挪得费力，鳃还在一张一合。
lines.en: At low tide I drag myself along, gills still opening and closing.

lines.zh: 海草丛动了一下，那是我在换方向。
lines.en: The kelp shifts once; that is me turning around.

lines.zh: 我沿着海底的沟走，那里没人来打扰。
lines.en: I follow a trench along the seabed, where nobody disturbs me.

lines.zh: 我卷起叶柄挪一步，再挪一步。
lines.en: I curl a frond and shift, then shift again.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我就势拐了个弯。
lines.en: The current pushes me and I let it turn me.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，随浪一下一下地点头。
lines.en: I hang in the water, nodding with each passing wave.

lines.zh: 我打了一个嗝，水里浮起一串小泡。
lines.en: I burp and a string of small bubbles rises through the water.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊平，像一片被冲上岸的海带。
lines.en: I flatten myself out like kelp washed up on the shore.

lines.zh: 盐味太重了，我慢慢尝自己的叶尖。
lines.en: The salt is heavy; I slowly taste my own frond tips.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，鱼会把我当成水草。
lines.en: When I keep still, fish mistake me for common weed.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶的光斑，一片，两片，三片。
lines.en: I count the light patches overhead: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 我的叶柄在水里绕了一圈，又松开。
lines.en: My stalk coils once in the water, then uncoils.

lines.zh: 潮声停了一会儿，我等着下一阵。
lines.en: The tide sound pauses a while; I wait for the next surge.

lines.zh: 我慢慢鼓动鳃，水从缝里挤出去。
lines.en: I work my gills slowly and water squeezes out of the slits.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼蹭过我的侧腹，我没理它。
lines.en: A small fish brushes my flank and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我在礁缝里打盹，只留一根须在外面。
lines.en: I doze in a reef crevice with one feeler left outside.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的尾，我懒得解开。
lines.en: Weeds snag my tail and I cannot be bothered to free it.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个气泡，看它升到水面破掉。
lines.en: I blow one bubble and watch it rise and break at the surface.

lines.zh: 海底很静，只有我的嗝声和水声。
lines.en: The seabed is quiet but for my burps and the water.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，先看你的鱼篓。
lines.en: I raise my eyes to you, and look at your fish basket first.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有海盐，我闻得出来。
lines.en: There is sea salt on your boots; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，水下看不真切。
lines.en: I tilt my head; things are never clear underwater.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边停下，鳃盖慢慢张开。
lines.en: I stop by your feet and slowly open my gill covers.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我把叶尖垂下去装死。
lines.en: When you look at me, I droop my fronds and play dead.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西，是生鱼吗。
lines.en: I stare at what you hold. Is that raw fish?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在浑水里只看得清轮廓。
lines.en: In murky water my eyes only make out shapes.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我跟着挪了半步。
lines.en: You step back half a pace, and I shuffle half a pace closer.

lines.zh: 我抬头，水面上你的影子晃得厉害。
lines.en: I look up; your shadow on the surface shakes badly.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，因为没有眼皮挡水。
lines.en: I do not blink, having no lids to keep the water out.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，你身上没有海带味。
lines.en: I sniff. You carry no scent of kelp at all.

lines.zh: 你的火把照下来，我的皮肤泛绿。
lines.en: Your torchlight falls on me and my skin turns green.

lines.zh: 我把须探出水面，碰了碰你的鞋尖。
lines.en: I poke a feeler above the surface and touch your shoe tip.

lines.zh: 你在岸边看我，我在水里看你。
lines.en: You watch me from the bank and I watch you from the water.

lines.zh: 我吃痛，整条海带都缩成一团。
lines.en: The pain makes my whole kelp body curl into a knot.

lines.zh: 你砍断我半截叶柄，断口渗出水。
lines.en: You cut half my stalk away and water seeps from the stump.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，吐出一串碎泡。
lines.en: I hiss once and spit out a burst of broken bubbles.

lines.zh: 疼得我鳃盖乱拍，水都搅浑了。
lines.en: The pain makes my gill covers flap and muddy the water.

lines.zh: 我退进海草丛，血在水里散开。
lines.en: I back into the kelp grass and blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我歪倒在沙上。
lines.en: That blow knocks me over onto the sand.

lines.zh: 我的叶尖被削掉，慢慢卷起来。
lines.en: My frond tip is cut off and slowly curls in.

lines.zh: 我叫不出声，只能闷闷地鼓鳃。
lines.en: I cannot cry out; I can only pulse my gills dully.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，把疼咽回喉咙里。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and swallow the pain back down.

lines.zh: 伤口进了海水，又疼又凉。
lines.en: Seawater gets into the wound, stinging and cold.

lines.zh: 生饱脂鱼肉一拿出来，我的鳃就抖了。
lines.en: The moment you show raw fatty fish, my gills quiver.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还在滴血，我已经游过来了。
lines.en: That fish is still dripping blood and I am already here.

lines.zh: 鱼肉上的油花，比什么都香。
lines.en: The oil on that fish smells better than anything.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃鱼，我整条海带都跟着晃。
lines.en: You wiggle the fish and my whole kelp body wiggles too.

lines.zh: 我张开口，等你把鱼丢进水里。
lines.en: I open my mouth and wait for you to drop the fish in.

lines.zh: 别用面包，我要的是生的肥鱼。
lines.en: No bread. What I want is raw, fatty fish.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手转了三圈，等鱼落下。
lines.en: I circle your hand three times, waiting for the fish to fall.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味穿透水，我顺着它追过来。
lines.en: The fish smell cuts through the water and I follow it here.

lines.zh: 我把叶柄卷起来，怕抢食时缠住自己。
lines.en: I curl my stalk up so it will not tangle when I snatch food.

lines.zh: 你手一低，我就把嘴凑到水面。
lines.en: Your hand drops and my mouth comes up to the surface.

lines.zh: 我吃饱了会打嗝，先给我那条鱼。
lines.en: I burp when I am full; give me that fish first.

lines.zh: 生鱼肉滑进喉咙，我舒服得眯起眼。
lines.en: Raw fish slides down my throat and I narrow my eyes in comfort.

lines.zh: 我闻到了鱼油，别的味道都淡了。
lines.en: I smell fish oil now; every other scent has faded.

lines.zh: 你拿着鱼走远，我就拖着海带跟上。
lines.en: You walk off with the fish and I haul my kelp after you.

lines.zh: 撞上我像撞一袋湿海带，又软又沉。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a sack of wet kelp, soft and heavy.

lines.zh: 我的叶柄缠住你的腿，一会儿就松开。
lines.en: My stalk wraps your leg briefly, then lets go.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的背滑过去，留下盐渍。
lines.en: You slide over my back and leave a smear of salt.

lines.zh: 我身上滑，你扶不住，只能摔进水里。
lines.en: I am too slippery to hold; you fall into the water.

lines.zh: 我的尾部蹭过你的膝盖，凉得像井水。
lines.en: My tail brushes your knee, cold as well water.

lines.zh: 别推，我这一身水都泼到你身上。
lines.en: Do not shove me, or all this water lands on you.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，自己倒先歪了。
lines.en: I bump into you and end up tilting over first.

lines.zh: 我们挤在礁缝里，谁也别想转身。
lines.en: We are wedged in the same reef crack, neither able to turn.

lines.zh: 我的鳃盖拍到你，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: My gill cover slaps you with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 你碰我的叶尖，它立刻缩回去。
lines.en: You touch my frond tip and it snaps back at once.

lines.zh: 我们并排漂着，叶柄在水下缠在一起。
lines.en: We drift side by side, stalks twined below the water.

lines.zh: 我吐泡，它也吐泡，泡在水面碰碎了。
lines.en: I blow bubbles, it blows bubbles, and they break together above.

lines.zh: 两条海带在水里打转，像一对船桨。
lines.en: Two kelp bodies spin in the water like a pair of oars.

lines.zh: 它用须碰我的鳃，我慢慢回碰一下。
lines.en: It touches my gills with a feeler and I slowly touch back.

lines.zh: 我们一起沉到沙上，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We sink to the sand together and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 它把最嫩的一截海带推给我。
lines.en: It pushes the tenderest strip of kelp over to me.

lines.zh: 潮水把我们推近，又轻轻推开。
lines.en: The tide pushes us together, then gently apart.

lines.zh: 我给它的窝衔了一圈海带边。
lines.en: I line its nest with a ring of kelp fronds.

lines.zh: 它唱不出声，只能一下一下鼓鳃。
lines.en: It cannot sing; it can only pulse its gills.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一片海草，谁也不许靠近。
lines.en: We guard the same patch of weed; nobody else may come near.

lines.zh: 我没有手，海带卷只能叼着走。
lines.en: I have no hands, so I carry the kelp roll in my mouth.

lines.zh: 地上那根海带，我用嘴拖回水里。
lines.en: I drag that kelp on the ground back into the water with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴把东西扫到脚边，再叼起。
lines.en: I sweep things to my feet with my tail, then pick them up.

lines.zh: 掉落的海带我一根根卷进叶柄里。
lines.en: One by one I coil the dropped kelp into my stalk.

lines.zh: 我张嘴接住，又漏了一半给沙子。
lines.en: I catch it in my mouth and spill half of it to the sand.

lines.zh: 别把东西丢在浅滩，我会当食物。
lines.en: Do not drop things in the shallows; I will take them for food.

lines.zh: 我叼起海带卷，走路就歪向一边。
lines.en: With the kelp roll in my mouth I walk tilted to one side.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉太干了，我吐回岸上。
lines.en: This rotten meat is too dry; I spit it back onto the bank.

lines.zh: 我只捡湿的，干的咽不下去。
lines.en: I only take what is wet; dry things will not go down.

lines.zh: 我把东西埋进沙里，回头再来取。
lines.en: I bury things in the sand and come back for them later.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我的海带丛，我抬起了头。
lines.en: You crushed my kelp bed, and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 血腥味在水里散开，我朝那边转。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我盯上你，因为你的腿伤在流血。
lines.en: I fix on you because the cut on your leg is bleeding.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼，让我改了主意。
lines.en: The fish in your hand makes me change my mind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，叶柄在身后绷直。
lines.en: I come closer slowly, my stalk drawn straight behind me.

lines.zh: 水面一颤，我就知道你的位置。
lines.en: The surface shivers and I know exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的脚踝，先不出声。
lines.en: I lock onto your ankle and make no sound yet.

lines.zh: 你离水太近，这是我动手的理由。
lines.en: You stand too near the water; that is reason enough.

lines.zh: 我张开鳃，把水里的味道吸进来。
lines.en: I open my gills and draw the taste of the water in.

lines.zh: 目标不远了，我的牙齿顶出唇外。
lines.en: The target is close and my teeth push past my lips.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底跟你，只露出叶尖。
lines.en: I trail you along the bottom, showing only a frond tip.

lines.zh: 你上岸，我在水边跟着走。
lines.en: You climb onto land and I follow along the waterline.

lines.zh: 我绕到礁石背面，从你看不到的地方。
lines.en: I slip behind the reef, where you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 每数到十下，我就近一步。
lines.en: Every ten counts, I close one more step.

lines.zh: 我不急，海水会把你推回来。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the sea will push you back.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，那里最容易咬。
lines.en: I watch your feet; that is the easiest place to bite.

lines.zh: 你在沙上留的脚印，我顺着追。
lines.en: I follow the prints you leave in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把气泡含住，免得暴露位置。
lines.en: I hold my bubbles in so they cannot give me away.

lines.zh: 你回头，我立刻沉进海带里。
lines.en: You turn around and I sink straight into the kelp.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，又回到你下游。
lines.en: I circle wide and come back downstream of you.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的小腿，尝到咸味。
lines.en: I bite your calf and taste salt.

lines.zh: 牙齿刮过皮，我吸了一小口水。
lines.en: My teeth scrape skin and I draw in a mouthful of water.

lines.zh: 我用叶柄抽你，留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: I lash you with my stalk and leave a wet stripe.

lines.zh: 这一口咬偏了，只扯下你的裤脚。
lines.en: The bite goes wide and only takes your trouser cuff.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，全身的海带都甩了起来。
lines.en: I lunge and all my kelp fronds whip up at once.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的牙还在原处张着。
lines.en: You pull back and my teeth stay open in the empty water.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，再用齿尖补一下。
lines.en: I ram your knee, then add a nip from my tooth tips.

lines.zh: 血混进水里，我的鳃猛地张开。
lines.en: Blood mixes with the water and my gills flare wide.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，回到海草丛里。
lines.en: I bite once and retreat into the kelp grass.

lines.zh: 这一下不深，你却觉得整条腿发凉。
lines.en: The cut is shallow, yet your whole leg goes cold.

lines.zh: 我从海带根里长出来，先长出鳃。
lines.en: I grow out of a kelp holdfast, gills first.

lines.zh: 潮水把我冲上浅滩，我就此醒了。
lines.en: The tide washes me onto the shallows and I wake there.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，四周全是摇摆的绿色。
lines.en: I open my eyes to swaying green on every side.

lines.zh: 我第一次打嗝，吐出一个空泡。
lines.en: I burp for the first time and release one empty bubble.

lines.zh: 沙里钻出一根叶柄，然后是我。
lines.en: A stalk pushes out of the sand, and then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 我落进礁缝，身体慢慢舒展开。
lines.en: I settle into a reef crack and slowly unfold.

lines.zh: 水是温的，我知道这是浅海。
lines.en: The water is warm; I know this is the shallows.

lines.zh: 我摸到自己的牙，先咬了一口海带。
lines.en: I find my own teeth and take a first bite of kelp.

lines.zh: 夜色里，我从海草丛中站起来。
lines.en: In the dark I rise up out of the kelp grass.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的沙，开始找吃的。
lines.en: I shake the sand off and start looking for food.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我鳃盖紧闭，我往下沉。
lines.en: The boiling water seals my gills shut and I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上滑下来，重重摔在浅滩。
lines.en: I slide off the reef and hit the shallows hard.

lines.zh: 我在空气里干着，鳃一张一合却吸不到水。
lines.en: In the air my gills open and close and pull nothing in.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从水里掀起来，海带碎了一地。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the water and kelp scraps rain down.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的叶柄，我拖着它游开。
lines.en: An arrow pins my stalk and I swim off dragging it.

lines.zh: 那股药水味钻进鳃里，我的叶尖发黑。
lines.en: The potion smell crawls into my gills and my fronds blacken.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我的叶片一片片发黄。
lines.en: I have gone hungry so long that my fronds yellow one by one.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，我的整条身体都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，连水都跟着消失了。
lines.en: I fall out of the world and even the water vanishes.
